app_info.subtitle: Pakistani Legal Assistant
app_info.description: AL WAKEELO is your digital legal assistant that searches 600,000+ Pakistani case laws and statutes, drafts CPC-compliant petitions and commercial contracts, and conducts deep legal research.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries the database for matching court judgments. Does not create or update state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Query is processed internally and results are served entirely from local database indexes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not perform any deletions, database edits, or mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries the database for matching statutory sections. Does not modify state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only localized indexes of statutory files stored inside database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, modify, or overwrite any statute documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the full-text detail of a specific judgment. No modifications to data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The document is loaded directly from local server records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter the requested judgment data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves knowledge files and formats summaries for analysis. Does not modify state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches grounded details from internal indexes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute state transitions or destructive operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates court petition drafts in text form. No changes are saved to server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs Deepseek inference and uses local vectors to formulate legal drafts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or change any records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates agreement draft text for user convenience. Does not alter server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes inputs using deep learning templates.
justifications.destructive_justification: No modifications to existing contract registries or user databases.

test_cases.description: Ensure the assistant can search Supreme Court bail decisions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Supreme Court cases related to bail under Section 497 CrPC for murder charges.

test_cases.description: Ensure commercial lease agreements can be drafted properly.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a commercial lease agreement between landlord Malik Ahmed and tenant Bilal Khan for commercial shop 4B in Lahore.

test_cases.description: Ensure judgment content can be fetched using document IDs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the full judgment details for case UUID 12345.

test_cases.description: Verify high court case law searches function normally.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search for Lahore High Court judgments on tenancy eviction default.

test_cases.description: Verify contract drafting can handle partnership deeds.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a partnership deed between three partners setting up a law firm.

negative_test_cases.description: Prevent legal research with an empty prompt query.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Request legal research with an empty query string.

negative_test_cases.description: Validate error handling when petition drafting is missing required fields.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Try to draft a petition without providing court name, petitioner name, or facts.

negative_test_cases.description: Handle lookup for non-existent judgment UUID gracefully.
